content.text: Stripe's availability map covers 46 countries. PayPal's risk engine flags accounts from Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and dozens of other markets before any human review occurs. Gumroad holds payouts for up to 30 days in certain regions. [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/lemon-squeezy-alternatives-restricted-countries-what-nobody-tells|COREMERCH guide to lemon]] Squeezy and Paddle are unavailable across most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not temporary oversights waiting to be corrected — they are deliberate structural decisions built into conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-5|payment]] infrastructure designed for Western banking systems. The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. It is [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-building-crypto-store-cloudflare-pages-works-how-3|How Building]] on infrastructure that does not have the problem in the first place. That means GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Stripe alternatives

When evaluating alternatives to Stripe, it's essential to consider what each option actually offers. Some platforms may promise ease of use but compromise on features, while others may offer advanced functionality at the cost of complexity. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, on the other hand, provides a comprehensive solution that includes automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. This approach empowers creators to take control of their digital commerce stack, ensuring a seamless and efficient customer experience.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like Stripe and PayPal often exclude specific countries due to regulatory restrictions or risk assessment. However, this approach can be detrimental to creators in these regions, limiting their access to global markets. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, by contrast, operates independently of these restrictions, providing a permanent structural alternative at the base layer. This means that creators in Nigeria and other restricted countries can finally participate in the global digital economy without being held back by payment platform limitations.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment speed, fees, and real costs are critical factors to consider when choosing a commerce infrastructure. Some platforms may boast fast payment processing but charge exorbitant fees, while others may offer low fees but compromise on payment speed. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, with its integration of automatic crypto payment verification, ensures fast and secure transactions with minimal fees. For example, NOWPayments offers a 0.5% fee, with recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON providing transactions under $0.10.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers creators with autonomy and flexibility.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership, automation, and delivery are essential aspects of a robust commerce infrastructure. Sovereign commerce infrastructure ensures that creators retain full ownership of their digital products and customer data. With automation, creators can focus on producing high-quality content, while the infrastructure handles payment processing, product delivery, and order management. Instant delivery of digital products is also guaranteed, providing customers with a seamless experience and increasing creator revenue.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

When deciding on a commerce infrastructure, creators must consider their specific situation and needs. For those seeking a comprehensive, autonomous, and reliable solution, sovereign commerce infrastructure is the clear choice. This approach provides a foundation for long-term growth, flexibility, and scalability, allowing creators to focus on their craft without worrying about payment platform restrictions or limitations. By investing in sovereign commerce infrastructure, creators can future-proof their digital businesses and thrive in the global market.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
NOWPayments provides fast and secure transactions with minimal fees.

This stack empowers creators to establish a robust commerce infrastructure, ensuring a seamless customer experience and unlocking new revenue streams.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign commerce infrastructure, follow these steps: choose a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, select a backend logic solution like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, set up order storage with Supabase or Google Sheets, configure file delivery with Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, and integrate automatic crypto payment verification with NOWPayments. With these components in place, creators can establish a comprehensive and autonomous commerce infrastructure, ensuring long-term growth and success.
